He worked closely with [[First Order Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] to track down the [[Resistance]], specifically one of their [[Team Colossus|cells]] headquartered in the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' built by the [[Galactic Empire]]. He later perished aboard his and Tierny’s vessel, the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''. ==Biography== ===Commander in the First Order Army=== {{Quote|When Major Vonreg and Commander Pyre first proposed the idea of collaborating with pirates, I was skeptical. Since then, you have done little to prove me wrong.|Phasma, to Kragan Gorr|}} [[File:CSSquad-TheNewTrooper.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Commander Pyre served as an officer a Stormtrooper Commander the Stormtrooper Corps of the First Order.]] Pyre was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[First Order officer|officer]] and stormtrooper commander in the [[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] in the [[First Order Army|Army]] of the [[First Order]] during the [[Cold War]] between the First Order and the [[Galaxy|galactic government]], the New Republic and the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary force[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] allied with the New Republic.{{Film|VII}} He and [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] proposed to [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] that the First Order collaborate with [[pirate]]s, which led to a partnership with Captain [[Kragan Gorr]] and the [[Warbird gang]]. The plan was for them to attack the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on the ocean planet [[Castilon]] in the [[Western Reaches]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]] enough so Captain [[Imanuel Doza]] ceded control of it to the First Order as part of the plan to use the others built by their predecessor, the [[Galactic Empire]], as part of a military supply line to refuel their [[First Order Navy|fleets]] for their upcoming [[First Order-Resistance War|War]] with the [[Resistance]]. After a failed [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] by the pirates, Kragan reported to Phasma and Vonreg, where Phasma stated her disappointment to Kragan and remarked she was skeptical from the beginning of the idea. ===Searching for Kel and Eila=== {{Quote|We'll only ask this once. Where are the children?|Pyre, to the Chelidae|}} [[File:HuntForKel-TheChildrenFromTehar.png|thumb|right|250px|Pyre's stormtroopers hunted two children, Kel and Eila, on the ''Colossus'' refueling station.]] Later, Pyre and two additional stormtroopers were sent to the ''Colossus'' in [[Hunt for Eila and Kel|search]] of two young fugitives, [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], who escaped the [[Attack on Tehar|destruction]] the First Order had wrought on their village on the [[planet]] [[Tehar]]. Pyre and his troopers arrived via [[Upsilon-class command shuttle]] and began searching the [[Colossus marketplace|marketplace]]. Pyre questioned the residants on the location of the fugitives. The commander eventually spots the Kel and Eila with [[Kazuda Xiono]], a [[Technician|mechanic]] who is unbeknownst to Pyre a Resistance [[spy]]. Pyre and his troops chased the fugitives across the station, eventually cornered them in the [[Colossus Engineering Level|engineering room]], where Kel declared he and his sister would rather die than be captured before apparently leaping to their deaths. Afterwards, Pyre reported to Phasma that his mission was complete, as the children were "no more." Unbeknownst to Pyre, [[Kazuda Xiono]], his friend [[Neeku Vozo]], and the [[Chelidae]] engineering staff faked Kel and Eila's deaths and the former reported the incident to [[Resistance pilot]] [[Ello Asty]] who passed it along to the leader of the Resistance, [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. ===Discussing sanctions=== {{Quote|This sanction will allow First Order to secure both your platform and skies. We'll find these pirates and eliminate them. To the benefit of both our parties…Don't take too long, Captain. We expect your answer soon.|Pyre, to Imanuel Doza|{{Resistance|Secrets and Holograms}}}} [[File:DozaPyreHolo-SynarasScore.png|thumb|left|250px|Pyre represented the First Order during its negotiations with Captain Imanuel Doza alongside Major Elrik Vonreg.|link=Special:FilePath/Doza_&_Pyre_hologram.png]] Following another pirate attack on the station, Captain Doza called Pyre to ask to look over the proposal he and Major Vonreg had to offer to make the pirate raids stop. The First Order officer replied that was excellent news and he would arrive to discuss it.{{Resistance|Synara's Score}} Pyre returned to the ''Colossus'', where he met with Doza to discuss sanctions that would allow the First Order to leave a [[garrison]] on the station to protect them from the pirates. When asked how many stormtroopers would be stationed, Pyre assured Doza there would be enough to stave off any further threats and his men were more than capable of eliminating them. Doza then inquired to how long the occupation would last, to which Pyre replied it was difficult to map out a timeline, citing pirates can be unpredictable. The meeting concluded when Doza said he would need [[time]] to review the sanctions before coming to a decision. Pyre advised him not to too take long, for he was expecting an answer soon, then was escorted off the station. As Pyre was about to board his shuttle, [[Jace Rucklin]] came running up, asking to speak with Doza about Xiono breaking into his [[Doza's office|office]] to make a copy of the First Order’s proposal at the order of his mentor Commander [[Poe Dameron]]. When asked if there was anything that should concern him, Doza assured Pyre it was nothing he could not handle so he departed the ''Colossus'' afterwards. ===Attempted theft of a phase connector=== {{Quote|Teroj.''"
"''Commander Pyre. I failed to secure the phase connector. My mission was sabotaged, and the goods were destroyed.''"
"''That is unfortunate. Captain Phasma will not be pleased. Report back at once.|Teroj Kee and Pyre|{{Resistance|Dangerous Business}}}} [[File:PyreHologram-DangerousBusiness.png|thumb|right|250px|Pyre was in contact with Teroj Kee, who was a mercenary of the First Order.]] Pyre later sent mercenary [[Teroj Kee]] with a pair of stormtroopers to the ''Colossus'' to acquire a [[phase connector]] from the [[Office of Acquisitions]] while its owners, [[Orka]] and [[Flix]], were absent. Since the phase connector was already preordered for a mining colony offworld, Kee stole it. Kee later reported to Pyre that his transport carrying the device was sabotaged and destroyed. Pyre stated this turn of events was unfortunate and Phasma would not be pleased before ordering Kee to return at once with his men. ===Kidnapping of Torra Doza=== {{Quote|You will take something precious from Captain Doza until he relinquishes the station.''"
"''And what would that be?''"
"''Something that is very close to him.|Pyre and Kragan Gorr, on abducting Torra Doza|T{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}}}} Pyre and Phasma conversed with Kragan, having grown impatient that his raids on the ''Colossus'' failed to make Captain Doza begging for their help. Gorr demanded triple payment to compensate for his losses or he would back out of their deal. With a nod from Phasma, Pyre instructed Gorr to [[Torra Doza's abduction|kidnap]] Captain Doza’s daughter [[Torra Doza|Torra]] to force him to relinquish the station. After Gorr's [[Synara San|inside agent]] on the ''Colossus'' helped abduct Torra, Pyre sent Vonreg to deliver Gorr’s payment when in truth it was to pull a double cross and fake a rescue and give his regards. The ruse convinced Doza to allow the First Order to leave a garrison on the ''Colossus'', as well earning goodwill among some of the residents. ===Occupation of the ''Colossus''=== ====Searching for a pirate spy==== {{Quote|Our job is simply to maintain order.|Pyre to Imanuel Doza, on the ''Colossus'' occupation|{{Resistance|The New Trooper}}}} Pyre later communicated with Captain Doza, who complained his stormtroopers were undermining his authority. The ex-[[Imperial officer]] reminded the First Order was to remain only until after the pirates were dealt with. Pyre argued the First Order was doing what was necessary to protect the ''Colossus'' and its residents and insisted Doza needed their protection and not to forget that with his bodyguard droid [[4D-M1N]] but the Captain was angry about it since he realized how evil the Empire was before he defected.{{Resistance|The First Order Occupation}} ====Searching for a pirate accomplice==== [[File:Pyre.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Doza accepted the presence of Commander Pyre's stormtroopers on the ''Colossus'' as a deterrent to piracy.]] Shortly afterwards, Pyre arrived to meet with Captain Doza who informed him the pirate spy he was looking for [[Escape from the Colossus|escaped]] and thus he believed there was no need to keep so many stormtroopers on the ''Colossus''. Pyre argued someone on the platform aided in her escape and stated he would find them. Doza then stressed he was still in command, to which Pyre was forced to agree. Pyre later inquired Doza as to why he left the Empire years ago. Doza insisted it was a [[Venisa Doza|personal choice]] and Pyre would not understand even if he explained why. Just then, [[Sergeant]] [[CS-812]] and his squadron entered Doza's office. Pyre requested Doza leave so he could speak with his stormtroopers in private. As soon as Doza left, Pyre was informed by Phasma that a [[Colossus garrison|full garrison]] was armed and on its way to the ''Colossus'' and instructed sympathizers on the platform may remain while the dissidents shall be arrested or otherwise "dealt with." Pyre then demanded their personal reports and CS-812 volunteered [[CS-515]], who summarized his patrol in an unprofessional manner. Having been earlier informed by CS-812 suspecting CS-515's conditioning to be erratic, Pyre ordered the defective stormtrooper be brought to their transport for a full mental wipe and reprogramming. CS-515 soon escaped, in which CS-812 initiated pursuit. CS-515 was eventually captured, though the First Order was unaware Xiono replaced him earlier to cover an incident with Kel and Eila. ====Taking control==== Later, while the ''Colossus'' was hosting a race, Pyre communicated with Doza via hologram, insisting the races held a security risk. When Doza defended the benefits of "positive morale" outweighed the risk, Pyre asked if he knew how the pirates were able to infiltrate the ''Colossus'', to which Doza reminded so long as he was in charge, so were the races allowed to continue. Pyre then conceded, but promised the discussion was not over. [[File:TakingCharge-CovertMissions.png|thumb|right|250px|Pyre seized control of the ''Colossus'' from Doza, placing the station under the direct rule of the First Order.]] Pyre later returned to the ''Colossus'' once more to meet with Doza again, stating he wanted to brief him on security matters and insisted he cancel all races until further notice. Though Doza protested that this would jeopardize the station's livelihood and community, Pyre said he understood but refuted that with the First Order defending the station, he could not risk an accident with undisciplined non-military pilots in the air. Doza was ultimately forced to concede to Pyre's demands, knowing that openly defying the First Order would put his constituents at risk. Pyre later led a group of stormtroopers to [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station]], where he found [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']], except for Xiono. Once he and his astromech droid [[CB-23]] entered the hangar, Pyre told him that he and his friends under arrest by command of the First Order since his [[Fireball|racer]] was caught by Major Vonreg flying in the [[Dassal system]] in the forbidden [[Sector Epsilon 51-3]] of the [[Unknown Regions]] with Dameron two days ago. However, Kaz and his friends managed to escaped from Pyre and his stormtroopers except for [[Tamara Ryvora]], who surrendered because she was sympathetic to the First Order due to being too young to understand how evil the Empire was. Later, Pyre took control of the ''Colossus'', arresting Captain Doza for "insubordination" and shot 4D-M1N when she was ordered to stop the First Order.{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 1}} ===Battle of Castilon=== When Xiono and his [[Team Colossus|Resistance cell]] retook the ''Colossus'', Pyre and [[First Order Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] tried to stop him from getting away again but failed and fled with Ryvora who joined the First Order.{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}} In the aftermath, he returned to his [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer]] the ''[[Thunderer]]'' with Agent Tierny. Captain Phasma ordered them to destroy the ''Colossus'' to keep it from falling into General Organa’s grasp since it was a valuable resource to her and warned him the consequences of failure would be their deaths which she would personally oversee. Pyre then inducted Ryvora into the First Order as a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]] [[pilot]] [[cadet]] codenamed DT-533.{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}} ===Ventures following the Battle of Castilon=== After Ryvora joined the First Order, she turned in her [[comlink]], which Pyre was able to use and find the location of the ''Colossus'' which was orbiting [[D'Qar]]. They caught the ''Colossus'' cell in the middle of [[Skirmish over D'Qar|salvaging]] coaxium from the ''[[Fulminatrix]]'', which got destroyed following the [[Battle of D'Qar]]. Though they almost got it, the ''Colossus'' was able to escape at the right time.{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} In their efforts to destroy the Resistance, Pyre worked closely with the disgraced officer General [[Armitage Hux]], whom he met before, in a planet-by-planet sweep, killng everyone who opposed the First Order.{{Databank|general-hux|General Hux}} At another point, Hux and Pyre were both to attend an important meeting aboard the ''[[Titan]]'', a supertanker fuel depot in the service of the First Order. Prior to the meeting, [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]] mentioned Pyre's meeting to Rvyora, as her [[flight instructor]] wanted her and Rucklin, codenamed DT-798, to go on a supply run to the station. Unknown to them, Xiono, Vozo, and CB-23 [[Infiltration of the Titan|were also aboard]], as they were undercover to steal a [[trans-binary deflector]] for the ''Colossus''. However, Xiono, due to his disguise as a technician, was separated from his compatriots by Hux, as the [[officer]] needed a guide to take him to the [[tower briefing room]] since the crew was unable to provide proper directions. Once their [[turbolift]] arrived, Pyre stood outside its door and greeted the General, making Xiono hide his face behind his [[datapad]] and disguise his voice. Pyre apologized for not meeting Hux directly upon arrival, explaining that they had not expected to have a meeting aboard the ''Titan'' on such short notice.{{Resistance|Station to Station}} In response, Hux said [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] wanted an update on the First Order's stock of refueling stations and hunt for the Resistance cells. After being asked for the truth, Pyre confirmed he had difficulties in acquiring a few, mentioning that one had become the headquarters of a Resistance cell, although he stated new intelligence would give them the chance to destroy it. Hux demanded he make it happen and there should be no more excuses, as he wanted every Resistance cell in [[the galaxy]] quashed and the Stormtrooper Commander said he understood after being asked. Once at the tower briefing room, Hux, Pyre, and the latter's stormtroopers entered, but Xiono was left outside, allowing him to reunite with his allies. After doing so, he warned Vozo that Pyre was aboard, meaning they needed to leave before he recognized them. [[File:PyreHuxConference-StationToStation.png|thumb|left|250px|Commander Pyre and General Armitage Hux met to discuss the Supreme Leader's goals for the First Order.]] CB-23 learned the deflector they needed was in the [[hyperdrive]] chamber, which the three eventually made it to. However, CB-23 was spotted by Rucklin, leading him to the hyperdrive chamber as well. Recognizing Xiono from his time on the ''Colossus'', he informed security about their presence. In the meeting, Pyre mentioned that, planet by planet, security was moving in the last of the Resistance cells, but the station's security alarm soon interrupted the conference. After Hux demanded to know what was happening, Pyre was informed there had been a [[Code Three]] in [[Engineering (Titan)|Engineering]], which upseted Hux, as the Stormtrooper Commander stated the ''Titan'' was secure. After Xiono and Vozo, who had managed to take the deflector, made it to sector 1305's [[blast door]], Pyre, two stormtroopers, and Hux spotted them. Pyre was surprised to see Xiono again, although he needed to tell Hux that Xiono was a Resistance spy. Pyre ordered the stormtroopers to fire, but CB-23, who was currently in the [[hangar]], closed the blastdoor to save Xiono and Vozo. Hux demanded they get the blast door open, but the two Resistance agents escaped to the hangar. Hux and Pyre did make it to the hangar, but they were unable to stop Xiono, Vozo, and CB-23 from entering an [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport]]. Pyre was one of the stormtroopers who fired on their [[transport]] and ordered to not let them escape, but the Resistance forces managed to escape to [[lightspeed]]. Afterwards, Hux demanded to know why Pyre could let the infiltration happen, he stated it was of no consequence, as they took the defector, making him believe the ''Colossus'' was becoming desperate. In response, Hux told the Stormtrooper Commander that desperation could be a dangerous thing, and reiterated the late Captain Phasma's orders for him and Tierny to find and destroy the ''Colossus''. Pyre then contacted Tierny and informed her Xiono was on the ''Titan'', stole a binary deflector, and escaped. She asked if Ryvora contacted him, making Pyre say she was reportedly with Rucklin who turned them in. After hearing this, Tierny noted if they worked the situation correctly, Ryvora could help them destroy the station. ===Battle on Aeos Prime=== After sending out probe droids, Pyre found of from one of them that the ''Colossus'' took refuge in the [[Aeos system]] when he and Tierny got an image of Xiono. After tracking down the ship, he sent TIEs and [[TIE/se Bomber]]s after them, but the ship still managed to escape. When Tierny said General Hux will be furious about the ''Colossus'' escaping from their grips again, Pyre told her that he was not concerned about the disgraced officer but Supreme Leader Ren.{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} ===Final stand and death=== [[File:DoYouUnderstand-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Supreme Leader Kylo Ren threatened to kill Commander Pyre and Agent Tierny if they failed to destroy the Resistance's ''Colossus'' cell again.]] In retaliation for helping the ''Colossus'', Agent Tierny and Commander Pyre participated in the [[suppression of the Aeos system]] with thirteen ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers. Pyre and Tierny reported the suppression to General Hux via hologram in her office, but he moved aside and Supreme Leader Ren addressed them. Ren made it known that he wanted the Resistance’s ''Colossus'' cell destroyed and used [[the Force]] to make them to stand and aim their blasters at each other, wanting them to understand that he would not tolerate anymore failures and was only giving them one more chance. Once Ryvora betrayed the First Order and Rucklin revealed the location of the ''Colossus'', the [[Battle of Barabesh|final hunt]] began. Pyre fought Xiono and his friends during the final hunt and the ''Thunderer'' once again fought the ''Colossus''. He tried to kill Xiono with a [[BL-155 Laser ax|Laser ax]], but CB-23 stopped him soon after. Pyre then managed to badly damage CB-23 before he was defeated by Xiono, who knocked him unconscious with a deactivated laser ax and the ''Thunderer'' exploded destroying it, killing him along with Rucklin and the crew''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' while Tierny met her end at the hand of Leader Ren for the cell's survival. ==Equipment== [[File:CommanderPyresBlaster-CM.png|thumb|left|250px|Pyre used a gold-plated version of the First Order stormtrooper armor and the F-11D blaster rifle.]] Pyre wore [[Pyre's armor|gold-plated stormtrooper armor]] and a [[Color|black]] [[pauldron]], and utilized a [[gold]]-plated [[F-11D blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Aside from Phasma, we also have the character Pyre, who is her sort of second-in-command. He needed to look unique as well, and we didn't want to stick with a silver theme, so I think it was fun that we brought in the gold. It makes him really distinct from her and the rest of the troopers.|Amy Beth Christenson on the development of Pyre|{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.6: Whispers of the First Order|video=ez0hN6svdX8|sw_url=video/whispers-of-the-first-order-resistance-rewind|date=2018-11-09}}}} Pyre is a character created for the animated series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. He is voiced by [[Liam McIntyre]]. The black-and-gold color scheme for Pyre's armor was chosen by the show's creator, [[Dave Filoni]]. Writer and executive producer [[Brandon Auman]] felt that the color scheme was likely in reference to the [[Wikipedia:Pittsburgh Steelers|Pittsburgh Steelers]],{{WookYouTube|ML1nYpSU0d0|Wookieepedia Interviews - Brandon Auman}} Filoni's hometown football team.{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-rewatch-duel-of-the-droids|text=''The Clone Wars'' Rewatch: A Spy Exposed in "Duel of the Droids"}}
